title: BHARATWIRE — Equity Report · 08 May 2026
catalyst: Bharat Wire Ropes is a margin-inflection and balance-sheet-transformation story — OPM expanded from 11% (FY19) to 26% (FY24); debt cut 84% to Rs. 102 Cr; India's second-largest wire rope maker now poised for a re-rating as capex cycle drives demand.
